# @sukunagg/ui

> SSR-safe, accessible React component library — 46 dark-first components built on Base UI and Tailwind v4 design tokens, WCAG AA, zero-runtime styling, RSC-ready, and documented for AI coding agents (llms.txt).

@sukunagg/ui is a React 18/19 component library: 75 components, SSR- and React Server Components-safe, WCAG AA contrast in both themes, dark-first with a light mode, styled with Tailwind v4 design tokens (`--sk-*`) on top of Base UI. Zero runtime styling.

Install: `bun add @sukunagg/ui` (or `npm i @sukunagg/ui`). Then pick one CSS path:

- **Tailwind v4 (primary):** in your global CSS add `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "@sukunagg/ui/theme.css"; @source "../node_modules/@sukunagg/ui/dist";`
- **No Tailwind:** `import "@sukunagg/ui/styles.css"` once.

Set the theme with `data-theme="dark"` (default/brand) or `"light"` on `<html>`. Every component below links to a Markdown page with its full API, variants, states and accessibility notes. Static components (Text, Badge, Card, Table…) work in Server Components; interactive ones are `'use client'`.

## Getting started

- [README](https://github.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui#readme): install, setup (Tailwind or precompiled CSS), theming, RSC notes, performance guidance
- [Full docs in one file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/llms-full.txt): every component page concatenated — paste this URL into your agent for complete context

## Components

- [Accordion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/accordion.md): Vertically stacked, expandable sections.
- [Alert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/alert.md): An inline message that draws attention to information, success, a caution, or an error.
- [AlertDialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/alert-dialog.md): Ask the user to confirm something that is hard to undo ("Delete project?", "Discard changes?").
- [Avatar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/avatar.md): A user/entity image with a graceful fallback (initials or icon) while loading or on error.
- [AvatarFrame](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/avatar-frame.md): Decorates a circular avatar with an animated frame: a crimson comet ring that circles it, a bone "premium" ring with a passing sheen and orbiting sparks, a live-broadcast halo with a LIVE pill, and an online/offline status dot cut cleanly out of the ring.
- [Badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/badge.md): A small, pill-shaped label for status and metadata — "LIVE", counts, tags.
- [BorderBeam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/border-beam.md): Sends a short light around the border of a card, a featured match, a season pass or a plan tile, to mark the one thing on a screen that deserves attention.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/breadcrumbs.md): Show the path to the current page and let users jump back up it.
- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/button.md): Triggers an action.
- [Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/card.md): A surface container that groups related content on an elevation.
- [Carousel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/carousel.md): A horizontal, one-slide-at-a-time content carousel for images, cards, or arbitrary nodes — the gap Slider (a range input) doesn't fill.
- [Checkbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/checkbox.md): A boolean checkbox.
- [Chip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/chip.md): A compact token for filters, selections, or tags — optionally removable.
- [Collapsible](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/collapsible.md): A single disclosure: "Show advanced options", "Read more", a sidebar group.
- [Combobox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/combobox.md): A text input with a filtered list of suggestions (free-text autocomplete).
- [ContextMenu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/context-menu.md): Offer contextual actions where the pointer is — right-click on desktop, long-press on touch.
- [Counter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/counter.md): Animates a number from a start to a target value — for stat tiles, KPIs, pricing, and dashboards.
- [Dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/dialog.md): A modal dialog.
- [Divider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/divider.md): A thin rule that separates content, horizontally or vertically.
- [Drawer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/drawer.md): A panel that slides in from an edge (nav, filters, details).
- [EmptyState](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/empty-state.md): Takes the place of content that isn't there: no results, nothing yet this season, a player not found, a service not answering.
- [Field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/field.md): Wraps one form control (an Input, Checkbox, Switch, …) with a label, an optional description and an optional error, and wires the id / aria-labelledby / aria-describedby / aria-invalid relationships for you.
- [FileUpload](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/file-upload.md): Lets people add a file by tapping, picking or dropping it, and shows what they added.
- [GlitchText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/glitch-text.md): Hits real text with short RGB-split glitch bursts, for elimination banners, match results and error or offline headings.
- [GradientText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/gradient-text.md): Fills text with a gradient (via background-clip: text) for wordmarks, hero headings, and accent phrases.
- [HoverCard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/hover-card.md): Preview richer context for a link without a click — a user card, a repo summary, a footnote.
- [Icon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/icon.md): A small set of line icons for the interface: disclosure chevrons, status glyphs for empty and error states, the theme toggle, search, external links.
- [Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/input.md): A single-line text input.
- [Kbd](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/kbd.md): Shows a key or a shortcut the way it looks on a keyboard: Esc, ⌘ K, Ctrl + Shift + L.
- [LootReveal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/loot-reveal.md): Flips a row of face-down item cards to reveal what a player won, one after another, with a rarity glow per card and a spark burst for legendaries.
- [MatchFound](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/match-found.md): The ready-check prompt a game client shows when the queue pops: a draining countdown ring, who on the team has accepted, and the Accept / Decline actions.
- [Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/menu.md): A dropdown menu of actions triggered by a button.
- [Meter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/meter.md): Show a scalar measurement within a known range: storage used, quota, password strength, a score.
- [NumberField](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/number-field.md): Enter a number precisely.
- [Pagination](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/pagination.md): Navigate between pages of results, with first/last always shown and ellipses in between.
- [Poll](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/poll.md): Asks one question with a few choices, optionally a write-in, and shows the results as bars with percentages.
- [Popover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/popover.md): Show a small, interactive panel next to the element that opened it — filters, quick settings, a share box, a date picker later.
- [Progress](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/progress.md): A horizontal progress bar, determinate or indeterminate.
- [Prose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/prose.md): Styles long-form text you don't control element by element: rules, legal drafts, patch notes, help articles rendered from Markdown, MDX or a CMS.
- [RadioGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/radio-group.md): Choose one option from a small set.
- [RankReveal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/rank-reveal.md): Celebrates a new rank with a crest that bursts in over a ray field while an orbit draws around it and the rank name rises into place.
- [RetroGrid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/retro-grid.md): A synthwave arena backdrop for hero sections: a crimson perspective grid scrolls toward the viewer under a glowing horizon, two spotlights sway in the sky and a light wave rolls out of the horizon every few seconds.
- [RowActions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/row-actions.md): Every data table eventually needs a per-row "Edit / Duplicate / Delete" menu.
- [ScrambleText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/scramble-text.md): Decodes a short label out of glyph noise into its real text, sweeping left to right — for match-found titles, lobby rosters, callsigns and reveal moments.
- [ScrollArea](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/scroll-area.md): Give a bounded region (a list, a code block, a sidebar) an overlay scrollbar that looks the same in every browser and matches the Sukuna surface, instead of the OS default.
- [Select](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/select.md): A single-select dropdown.
- [ShinyText](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/shiny-text.md): Sweeps a soft light band across dimmed text — for "New" flags, premium labels, and subtle CTA emphasis.
- [Skeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/skeleton.md): A placeholder shimmer shown while content loads.
- [Slider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/slider.md): Pick a number from a range by dragging or with the keyboard.
- [Sparkline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/sparkline.md): A word-sized trend with no axes: a rating over the last games, matches per day, a win/loss streak.
- [Spinner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/spinner.md): An indeterminate loading indicator (CSS spin).
- [StatTile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/stat-tile.md): One headline number with what it means: a label, the value, a caption line (record, breakdown, scope) and optionally a signed change against a named period and a small trend.
- [Stepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/stepper.md): Show progress through an ordered sequence of steps.
- [Switch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/switch.md): An on/off toggle for an immediate setting (not form submission).
- [Table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/table.md): Present tabular data with Sukuna styling.
- [Tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/tabs.md): Switch between panels of related content.
- [Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/text.md): The typographic primitive.
- [Textarea](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/textarea.md): Multi-line free text: comments, descriptions, messages.
- [Timeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/timeline.md): Lists things in the order they happened or will happen, with a time or label on the left: a match's objectives, a team's night at a tournament, an audit log, a changelog.
- [Toast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/toast.md): Transient notifications.
- [ToggleGroup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/toggle-group.md): Pick one option from a small, mutually-exclusive set (segmented control), or toggle several independent options (a formatting toolbar).
- [Tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/tooltip.md): A hover/focus tooltip for supplementary text.
- [VideoPlayer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/video-player.md): Plays a single video with Sukuna-branded controls instead of each browser's native chrome, so video looks the same in Chrome, Safari and Firefox and matches the rest of the library.
- [XpLevelUp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/xp-level-up.md): Celebrates an XP gain that crosses a level: the bar fills to the top, flashes once, the badge bursts and counts up to the new level, then the bar settles at the progress into that level.

## @sukunagg/charts

Install `bun add @sukunagg/charts` (peers on `@sukunagg/ui` for its `theme.css` tokens, EmptyState and Skeleton). Tailwind apps add `@source "../node_modules/@sukunagg/charts/dist"`; others `import "@sukunagg/charts/styles.css"`.

- [BarChart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/bar-chart.md): Compares amounts across categories: games per placement, kills per weapon by season, revenue per plan per month, pick rate per agent.
- [DataBar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/data-bar.md): A number with a small bar under it, for comparing rows of a table at a glance: damage to champions in a scoreboard, pick rate in a meta table.
- [DonutChart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/donut-chart.md): Shows a part-to-whole split with few parts: time played by role, games by queue, plans by share.
- [Heatmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/heatmap.md): A calendar of activity: one square per day, weeks as columns, darker or brighter by how much happened — games played per day, commits, sessions.
- [LineChart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/line-chart.md): Shows change across an ordered axis: rating over the last 30 matches, damage per round by role per week, placement per game, gold difference per minute.
- [RadialGauge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/radial-gauge.md): One value against a range, drawn as a 270° arc with the number in the middle: LP to the next division, plan usage, a score out of 100.

## @sukunagg/fx

Install `bun add @sukunagg/fx` (peers on `@sukunagg/ui` for its `theme.css` tokens; client islands over a server-rendered CSS poster). Tailwind apps add `@import "@sukunagg/fx/theme.css"; @source "../node_modules/@sukunagg/fx/dist"`; others `import "@sukunagg/fx/styles.css"`.

- [BracketBeam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/bracket-beam.md): Shows a single-elimination tournament bracket and sends a beam of light along the champion's path, round by round, until the trophy card ignites.
- [FlowField](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/flow-field.md): A matchmaking-screen backdrop where crimson particles stream along a drifting noise field and swirl around the content you centre on it.
- [HoloCard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/holo-card.md): A holographic foil card that wraps your card art and tilts toward the pointer or the arrow keys.
- [Lightning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/lightning.md): A crackling crimson lightning bolt behind a hero banner, drawn by one WebGL shader over a server-rendered SVG poster.
- [ParticleField](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sukuna-gg/sukunagg-ui/main/docs/llms/particle-field.md): An always-dark hero stage where crimson embers rise out of a glowing haze behind your overlay content, for season launches, event banners, landing heroes and "play now" panels.
